svg.text: STM32H747 internal DAC -> SMA input -> bipolar SMA output | 2 channels | DRAFT
Separate analog daughter circuit. VREF+=3.3V baseline; +/-12V and common GND supplied by the reviewed power block.
No 50-ohm termination. Use an MCU/source-side buffer for coax; native MCU CL accuracy condition is <=50pF.
7=5V relay supply 8=external fail-off low-side coil driver 9/10=GND
J5.8 is NOT a GPIO input: drive only with a rated transistor + flyback diode, gated by power-good AND MCU enable.
01 Reference tracking | VBIAS=MCU VREF+/2, buffered | spare amplifier terminated
02 Channel A | nominal Vout=(100k/14k)*(Vin - MCU VREF+/2)
VREF+=3.3V: target input 0.25..3.05V for +/-10V; H747 buffered permitted range 0.2..3.1V.
100 ohm + 22pF local HF feedback; DC feedback senses BEFORE mute relay
02 Channel B | nominal Vout=(100k/14k)*(Vin - MCU VREF+/2)
VREF+=3.3V: target input 0.25..3.05V for +/-10V; H747 buffered permitted range 0.2..3.1V.
100 ohm + 22pF local HF feedback; DC feedback senses BEFORE mute relay
03 Power / mute | 100nF on EACH supply at EACH IC; add local bulk capacitors during PCB integration.
K1: unenergized -> both outputs GND; energized -> calibrated signal
MCU enable AND hardware power-good must control the external coil driver.
DRAFT: no PCB routing. Select precision resistor MPNs, relay footprint and external fail-off driver before manufacture.
Validate cable stability and relay contact/release transients. Normal shutdown: mute first, wait for release, then remove analog rails.
